title: Lunar Lander
description: Land a lunar capsule by choosing rocket burn rate and duration.
versionOrder: Comparison history starts with Jim Storer’s 1969 FOCAL listing, then an electronic transcription of the published BASIC Lunar. The recovered BASIC adaptation adds plotting and adjustable duration; its exact intermediate source edition and save date are unknown.

versions.label: LUNAR LANDER
versions.note: Untouched recovered save. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical matching variants/repeated saves; runtime untested

attribution.text: A BASIC adaptation of Jim Storer’s 1969 Lunar Lander.
